workflow.name: Feature Delivery
workflow.description: New capability delivered through the full spec-driven chain, retaining the three approval gates do-flow stops at today.
workflow.handoff: After the final gate, commit and merge through do-git, which is outside this workflow.
workflow.readinessNote: Gated by the 'feature' readiness template at the implementation stage.

stages.purpose: Resolve the idea into requirement.md with zero unresolved clarification markers.
stages.kindDescription: Elicit and record what is actually being asked for.

gatesAfter.name: Unresolved clarifications
gatesAfter.prompt: requirement.md still carries unresolved [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers. Resolve each one before design starts.

stages.purpose: Turn requirement.md into architecture, interface, and data-contract decisions in design.md.
stages.kindDescription: Decide system shape, interfaces, and data contracts.

stages.purpose: Produce plan.md: the constitution check and the dependency-ordered task checklist.
stages.kindDescription: Break decided work into a dependency-ordered, owner-scoped task list.

gatesAfter.name: Before implementation
gatesAfter.prompt: requirement.md, design.md, and plan.md are ready. Proceed to implementation?

stages.purpose: Execute plan.md's checklist through the specialist archetypes.
stages.kindDescription: Author or modify source. The only kind that mutates the tree, and therefore the only kind a readiness template can gate.

stages.purpose: Run the project's builds and test suites over the delivered change.
stages.kindDescription: Run builds, test suites, and coverage against the tree as it stands.

stages.purpose: Review the delivered change and report an approval status.
stages.kindDescription: Assess a change or a body of code and report findings; produces judgement, not edits.

gatesAfter.name: Before commit or merge
gatesAfter.prompt: Review is complete. Proceed to commit and merge?

gates.name: Unresolved clarifications
gates.prompt: requirement.md still carries unresolved [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers. Resolve each one before design starts.

gates.name: Before implementation
gates.prompt: requirement.md, design.md, and plan.md are ready. Proceed to implementation?

gates.name: Before commit or merge
gates.prompt: Review is complete. Proceed to commit and merge?

terminalStage.purpose: Review the delivered change and report an approval status.
terminalStage.kindDescription: Assess a change or a body of code and report findings; produces judgement, not edits.

message: Task class 'feature' selects the Feature Delivery workflow: discovery → design → planning → implementation → verification → review.
